name: HarperDB Cloud
description_en:
HarperDB Cloud is a product in the Database management category. Its directory profile covers Virtualization, Relational Interface, Queries, Performance Analysis, Monitoring, Database Conversion, Data Search, Data Replication.

Additional listed capabilities include Data Migration, Creation (Development), Backup. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: move supported records between systems; create additional copies of selected data. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出数据迁移、创建与开发、数据备份。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

research_gaps.en: Official harperdb.io homepage redirects to harper.fast, now Harper application/data runtime and Fabric. Current pricing on harper.fast and actual installation documentation on docs.harperdb.io were read. The current home/pricing and essential docs cross registered domains, which the same-domain source rule cannot encode without changing shared authority/schema. No false URLs or validator edits. The installation docs distinguish harper from Elastic2.0 pro/Fabric, and development samples/default credentials are not production acceptance. Current complete profile remains pending authority support.
